apps.name: RagaMentor-iOS
apps.versionDescription: v1.5.1 — Supersedes v1.5.0 (whose test gate failed, so it never replaced the release): the waveform container for touch forwarding is now derived topologically from the probes, not picked by frame height, and the hit-test coverage is split into three named tests. The LoopLab editor push at the library stack root from v1.5.0 is unchanged.
apps.localizedDescription: RagaMentor native: LoopLab — slow down songs, keep pitch, loop sections. Built by GitHub Actions + fastlane on every push to main.

versions.localizedDescription: Phrases migrate to the shared SequencePlayer (P-C).
